pages.text: $(bold)Tanks$() hold a single fluid each: 16, 64, 256 or 1024 buckets from Basic to Hyper. They work on their own or as part of an advanced storage system, where each tank draws a little power.

Right-click with a bucket to fill or drain. Right-click with an empty hand to open the tank, where you can lock it to its current fluid so it only ever accepts that fluid, even when empty.$(br2)Broken tanks keep their fluid. Upgrading a tank by crafting destroys its contents, so empty it first.
